techParks.name: Prestige Tech Park
techParks.description: Prestige Group's campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli, built as named blocks (Mercury, Etamin, Exora, Falcon, Lotus); it houses Nutanix's 200,000 sq ft India HQ in the Mercury Block and Confluent's engineering hub in Etamin, with Adobe and Amadeus among other mapped tenants.

techParks.name: Embassy TechVillage
techParks.description: Embassy Office Parks REIT's flagship SEZ-and-non-SEZ campus on the Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli (the former Vrindavan Tech Village), with lettered blocks (Aster 2A, Trillium 5I/5J, Block 8); Rubrik signed a 2.07 lakh sq ft lease here in January 2025, Progress and MathWorks name their blocks, and Cisco runs an SEZ unit.

techParks.name: Embassy GolfLinks Business Park
techParks.description: Embassy's business park off the Intermediate Ring Road beside the KGA golf course, made up of named buildings (Pine Valley, St. Andrews, Princeville, Sunriver, Cherry Hills, Cyber Park); it is the densest cluster of SaaS and observability vendors in the city, with New Relic, Datadog, ServiceNow, Autodesk, Trellix and an OpenText WeWork all naming buildings here.

techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park
aliases: Bagmane Tech Park CV Raman Nagar
techParks.description: Bagmane Developers' park in C V Raman Nagar with named buildings (Quay, Commerz 1/02, Laurel, Olympia, Tridib, Parin); it hosts a security and data-management cluster - Palo Alto Networks and Commvault in Quay, Informatica in Commerz 02, Splunk's AppDynamics unit in Commerz, OpenText in Laurel and Olympia, and a Cisco office in Commerz 1.

techParks.name: Bagmane Constellation Business Park
techParks.description: Bagmane's business park at Doddanekundi Circle on the Outer Ring Road, with star-named buildings (Carina, Orion, Virgo, Luxor, Falcon); Red Hat's Bangalore Engineering Office is on the 10th floor of Carina and Zscaler occupies the 11th floor of Orion.

techParks.name: Bagmane Capital
techParks.description: Bagmane's newest Outer Ring Road campus next to Constellation; Databricks opened a 105,000 sq ft Bengaluru R&D office here in 2025, and Google renewed a large lease in the park.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecospace
techParks.description: RMZ's Bellandur campus on the Outer Ring Road, numbered Campus 1A-1C through 4A/4B with an SEZ portion marketed as Pritech Park SEZ; Intuit India's development centre sits in Campus 4A/8 and the former VMware campus (Campus 1A/1C) is now mapped as Broadcom.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecoworld
techParks.description: RMZ's large campus east of Ecospace on the Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli, built as numbered buildings (Ecoworld 1 to 8) with an SEZ; Cadence's Bengaluru design centre is mapped at Campus 4A/4B on RMZ Ecoworld Road, and OSM records SAP Ariba and Microsoft offices nearby. Centroid is a Nominatim hit on 'RMZ Ecoworld Internal Road', not a polygon.

techParks.name: Prestige Technostar
techParks.description: Prestige Group's two-building office campus off ITPL Main Road in Doddanekundi Industrial Area (also home to an Executive Centre flexible-office site); o9 Solutions' Bengaluru office is Level 9 of Building 2.

techParks.name: Brigade Tech Gardens
techParks.description: Brigade Enterprises' office campus in Brookefield off ITPL Main Road, laid out as lettered blocks (B1, B2 ...); Manhattan Associates India's development centre occupies the 5th and 6th floors of B1 Block.

techParks.name: RMZ Infinity
techParks.description: RMZ's multi-tower office park on Old Madras Road at Benniganahalli (towers A-E); Freshworks' Bengaluru office is on the 7th floor of Tower D and Synopsys has an India office here.

techParks.name: RMZ Millenia
techParks.description: RMZ's business park at 1 & 2 Murphy Road, Ulsoor (towers A-D); Fortinet Technologies India's Bengaluru office and 2016 Innovation Centre occupy units in Tower C.

techParks.name: Mantri Commercio
techParks.description: Mantri Developers' twin-tower office building on the Outer Ring Road near Sakra World Hospital; Blue Yonder (formerly JDA) keeps its Bengaluru office in Tower A.

techParks.name: Divyasree Technopolis
techParks.description: DivyaSree Developers' office campus on Old Airport Road at Yemalur (near its 77 East and 77 Town Centre projects); Sprinklr's Bengaluru office is the 3rd-floor East Wing. The point is a geocode of the adjacent DivyaSree 77 East, so treat it as approximate.

techParks.name: SJR Primeco Union City
techParks.description: SJR Primeco's office development on ITPL Main Road at Kadugodi Gate, Whitefield; Epicor's India development centre is on the 12th floor of Block B.

techParks.name: Prestige Trade Tower
techParks.description: Prestige's high-rise office tower at 45/1 Palace Road in the CBD; Automation Anywhere's India headquarters is on the 12th floor.

techParks.name: UB City
techParks.description: Luxury mixed-use complex on Vittal Mallya Road with the Concorde, Canberra and Comet office towers; SAS India's Bengaluru office is a Regus suite on Levels 14-15 of Concorde Towers.

techParks.name: Cessna Business Park
techParks.description: Prestige-developed campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road best known as Cisco's Bengaluru campus (Cisco lists two office codes here); OSM also records Salesforce and Walmart offices in the park.

techParks.name: NetApp Bangalore Campus
techParks.description: NetApp's own corporate campus on ITPL Main Road at Hoodi, its largest engineering site outside the United States.

coverageNotes: VERIFIED WITH OFFICIAL PAGES (high): Nutanix, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Zscaler (2 offices), Red Hat, SUSE, Progress, MongoDB, Zoho, Automation Anywhere, Informatica, SAS, Splunk/AppDynamics, Cisco (4 offices), New Relic, Datadog, Manhattan Associates, Commvault (2), MathWorks, Atlassian, OpenText (4), Databricks (press release). VERIFIED WITH ONE SECONDARY SOURCE (medium; mostly Built In office pages, cross-checked against OSM POIs where possible): ServiceNow, Snowflake, Confluent, UiPath, Freshworks, Infor, Epicor, Blue Yonder, o9, Sprinklr, Zendesk, Couchbase, Cloudflare, Autodesk, Unisys, NetApp, Cloud Software Group, Trellix, Intuit, Rubrik (Embassy REIT lease filing via two outlets), Pure Storage (own page says only 'heart of Bangalore'; OSM Church Street POI), Cadence and Broadcom/VMware (OSM POIs with full addresses; company pages returned HTTP 403). LOW CONFIDENCE, INCLUDED WITH THE CAVEAT WRITTEN ON THE OFFICE: Okta (press release names only 'S.R. Nagar'; locality centroid), Elastic (aggregator says EGL/Sunriver; park centroid), Siemens Digital Industries Software and Dassault Systemes (OSM POIs only), Intuit's Embassy TechVillage site (OSM only). DELIBERATELY LEFT OUT - NO BENGALURU OFFICE: Workday (People Matters, 2 Dec 2025: teams in Pune, Chennai, Mumbai; Bengaluru and Delhi offices planned for FY2027 - https://www.peoplematters.in/news/business/workday-strengthens-its-commitment-to-india-as-a-strategic-growth-and-innovation-hub-with-new-investments-47503); GitLab (all-remote, Bengaluru roles are remote/hybrid, no office); Teradata (Built In lists Gurugram, Hyderabad, Mumbai only); Kinaxis (own contact page lists Chennai and Hyderabad only); Anaplan (own contact page lists Gurugram and Mumbai only); PTC (Built In lists Chennai and Pune only; Bengaluru appears only as job locations). LEFT OUT - BENGALURU PRESENCE CONFIRMED BUT NO ADDRESS OR LOCALITY COULD BE SUBSTANTIATED, SO NO COORDINATES: HashiCorp (own blog describes a Bengaluru co-working space but names neither it nor the area; now part of IBM), CrowdStrike (Built In lists 'Bengaluru, India' only), Dynatrace (Built In lists Bengaluru only; dynatrace.com office pages 404/redirect-loop), Akamai, Twilio, HubSpot (Built In pages with no address). LEFT OUT - COULD NOT CHECK AT ALL (official pages 403/404/503 and the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted after the first 20 queries): Trimble, Hexagon, Bentley, Ansys, Qualtrics, Intercom, Slack (Salesforce). Software AG's ETV office (Built In: 5th & 6th floor, Embassy Tech Village SEZ) is omitted because the company's webMethods business and staff moved to IBM in 2024 and the remaining entity was renamed, so current occupancy is uncertain. OTHER CAVEATS: Zoho is classed MNC despite being unlisted because a 15,000-plus-employee Indian multinational labelled MID_SIZE would mislead; Freshworks' origin is 'Foreign' because its parent is headquartered in San Mateo although it was founded in Chennai; Databricks and o9 are STARTUP (venture-funded, founded after 2005, still private) and Automation Anywhere is MNC because it was founded in 2003. Unisys's techPark is RGA Tech Park on the strength of the surrounding OSM polygon while the OSM POI tag says SJR iPark. Older/legacy sites were not recorded as separate offices: Manhattan Associates' earlier EPIP Zone building, Red Hat's IBC Knowledge Park office, Unisys at Purva Premier (Residency Road), Infor near Church Street, Freshworks' earlier Bellandur POI, Cisco Video Technology (ex-NDS) at Pritech Park, VMware's Kalyani Magnum campus - each appears only as an OSM POI with no current source. Headcounts are null except Zscaler (about 2,400 per a GCC tracker that also prints 2,904; treat as approximate). Coordinates flagged park-centroid or photon are building-level only where the evidence says so; several (Snowflake, ServiceNow Fairway, OpenText Infinity, Sprinklr) are street- or neighbour-level geocodes and are marked medium for that reason.
